college.name: Kingston Engineering College
college.address: Chittoor Main Road, Vellore, Tamil Nadu – 632 059
college.about: Kingston Engineering College is an autonomous institution approved by AICTE and affiliated to Anna University. Established with a vision to provide quality technical education, KEC has achieved NAAC 'A' grade accreditation and NBA accreditation for several programmes.

cse.name: Computer Science & Engineering
cse.research_centre: Recognized Research Centre by Anna University
cse.about: The CSE department was established in 2008 with an intake of 60, now expanded to 240. NBA accredited (2018, 2022). The department has a recognized research centre by Anna University with an H-index of 19.

ece.name: Electronics & Communication Engineering
ece.about: ECE department offers a rigorous curriculum in electronics, communication systems, VLSI and embedded systems with modern labs.

mech.name: Mechanical Engineering
mech.about: Mechanical Engineering department with well-equipped workshops and labs covering design, manufacturing, thermal and production engineering.

it.name: Information Technology
it.about: IT department focuses on software development, networking, cloud computing and cyber security with industry-standard infrastructure.

aids.name: Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
aids.about: AI & Data Science programme at Kingston covers Python, ML, deep learning and big data analytics as core focus areas.

aiml.name: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
aiml.about: AI & ML department covers computer vision, NLP, deep learning and autonomous systems.

csbs.name: Computer Science & Business Systems
csbs.about: CSBS is a TCS curriculum-aligned programme combining computer science with business systems, ERP, analytics and management skills.

arch.name: Architecture
arch.about: B.Arch is a 5-year programme emphasizing design thinking, sustainability, CAD/BIM and studio culture with regular design studios and jury evaluations.

mba.name: Master of Business Administration
mba.about: MBA programme at Kingston offers specializations in Finance, Marketing, HR and Operations with case-study methodology, live projects and industry mentorship.

sh.name: Science & Humanities
sh.about: The S&H department provides foundation courses in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, English Communication and Management for all engineering programmes.

hostel.includes: Accommodation, mess (3 meals/day), electricity, water, WiFi

intents.title: Admissions at Kingston 🎓
content_points: 📌 B.E. / B.Tech: 12th pass (PCM). Through TNEA counselling or Direct Admission
📌 B.Arch: 12th + Mathematics + NATA score. 5-year programme, 40 seats
📌 M.Tech: B.E./B.Tech in relevant branch. 2-year programme
📌 MBA: Any graduation + CAT/MAT/TANCET score. 2-year programme
📌 Lateral Entry: Diploma holders directly to 2nd year B.E./B.Tech
✅ Admissions: Via TNEA, Direct Quota, NRI/Management Quota
📞 Admission Helpline: +91-75400-37999 | admission@kingston.ac.in

intents.title: Fee Structure 2026–27 💰
content_points: 📍 B.E. / B.Tech: ₹1,60,000 tuition + ₹11,800 university fee = ~₹1,71,800 per annum
📍 B.Arch: ₹1,80,000 tuition + university fee = ~₹1,91,800 per annum
📍 M.Tech: ₹1,50,000 per annum
📍 MBA: ₹2,00,000 per annum
🏠 Hostel: ₹1,00,000/year (accommodation + mess + WiFi all included)
🚌 Transport: ₹50,000 – ₹1,00,000/year (depends on distance)
💡 Scholarships: SC/ST/MBC full reimbursement • Sports quota • Merit scholarships • Girl child concession

intents.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid 🏆
content_points: 🎓 TN Govt. SC/ST/MBC: Full tuition reimbursement for families with income < ₹2.5 lakh/year (via scholarship.tn.gov.in)
🌟 Merit Scholarship: Top 10% of students — partial to full tuition waiver
⚽ Sports Quota: Fee concession for state/national-level sports achievers

🌍 NRI/International: Special fee structures and payment plans available
📋 Apply: Contact admission office. Scholarships awarded at the time of admission.
